clips.title: The story
paras: Grimtotem warriors hold Camp Aparaje in the eastern heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. The tribe slaughtered the peaceful tauren who settled there and claimed the outpost.

Camp Aparaje lies among the Stonetalon crags, where peaceful tauren once sought a quiet life in the highlands. Raiders from nearby Grimtotem Post struck under Grundig Darkcloud's lead. The attackers butchered villagers or drove them away. Survivors such as Makaba Flathoof mourn the loss of their home and fear for kin taken captive.

Grimtotem warriors now occupy Camp Aparaje as a forward base for their aggressive tribe in the region. Many Grimtotem settlements bear blue markings, but the great totem here is carved with deep crimson paint.
